name: Toggle mock mode in the Atlas
summary: A reviewer switches the Atlas between live-repo and fixture data using the ?mock query-param or by setting LEAFCUTTER_MOCK=1, observes the mock-mode badge appear, and confirms all 8 views render from the bundled fixture repo. FIXTURE — bundled mock data for Atlas mock mode.

steps.label: Set LEAFCUTTER_MOCK=1
steps.description: The reviewer starts the Atlas development server with mock mode switched on.

steps.label: Observe mock-mode badge
steps.description: The reviewer opens the Atlas and sees the amber 'Mock mode' badge in the sidebar.

steps.label: Verify all views render from fixtures
steps.description: The reviewer opens the roadmap, flows and atlas pages and sees curated sample data instead of the live repository.

acceptance_scenarios.given: the Atlas is started with LEAFCUTTER_MOCK=1
acceptance_scenarios.then: the mock-mode badge is visible and all data comes from the bundled fixtures
